The Utah Jazz have claimed center Tony Bradley off free agency waivers, sources tell ESPN. Bradley was the Jazz's No. 28 pick in 2017 and now returns where he spent his first 3 NBA seasons.
The New York Knicks are waiving Bruce Brown, sources tell ESPN. James Wiseman is set to make the Knicks regular season roster as a reserve center.
The Washington Wizards are signing Reece Beekman to a two-way NBA deal, converting his exhibit 10 to the team’s final slot, sources tell ESPN.
The Philadelphia 76ers are signing 7-foot-6 center Tacko Fall to a two-way NBA contract, sources tell ESPN. Fall enters his fourth NBA season after the 76ers convert his exhibit 10 deal.

The NFL fined Bradley Chubb $14,329 for taunting.

The NFL fined Jets safety Minkah Fitzpatrick $17,911 for the hit that knocked out Browns WR KC Concepcion last week, plus another  $11,941 for a facemask earlier in the game.
